title: Section 9 — World events
description: World event triggered on the planet. Domain key: planet + seed + pos. May be empty. When merging, save A takes precedence.

planet.description: Numeric id of the planet where the event occurred

pos.description: 3D position of the event, formatted as 'x,y,z'

owner.description: Identifier of the event owner (0 = world)

rot.description: 3D rotation of the wreck object, formatted as 'x,y,z,w'

wrecksWOGenerated.description: Whether the objects of a wreck have already been generated

woIdsGenerated.description: Comma-separated list of the ids of the objects generated by the event

woIdsDropped.description: Comma-separated list of the ids of the objects dropped by the event
